# Countable and uncountable nouns

## Основная идея
Countable nouns can be numbered: one apple, two apples. Uncountable nouns normally refer to substances, categories or abstract quantities: water, information, advice. Use many/few with countable plurals and much/little with uncountable nouns. Units allow measurement: a glass of water, a piece of advice.

## Разбор на примере
There are many books but not much time. She gave me two pieces of advice.

## Как применять знания
1. Определи ключевое понятие или правило из темы.
2. Найди в примере конкретные факты, которые подтверждают правило.
3. Сформулируй вывод и проверь его на другом случае.

## Типичная ошибка
Information and advice are normally uncountable in standard English; avoid informations and advices.

## Проверь понимание
Choose: “How ___ information do we need?”
levels.easy:
## Объяснение простыми словами
Countable nouns can be numbered: one apple, two apples.

**Пример:** There are many books but not much time. She gave me two pieces of advice.

**На что обратить внимание:** Information and advice are normally uncountable in standard English; avoid informations and advices.
